body: Credibility-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.75 (naive sector base rate 0.74) that: KPIT FY27 EBITDA margin (company-reported) is >=20.5%. Probability set only by the pre-stated rule (research_notes/Promise tracker pilot/IT_MIDCAPS_peer_comparison.md section 5 = AUTO_COMPONENTS_peer_comparison.md section 5, unchanged): p0 = 0.74 (leave-one-out peer strict delivery rate, category 'margin', all-category fallback, n=6); SAC +6.6 pts x weight 0.2 (N=5) -> p = 0.75. Evidence: Q4FY26 call (07-May-2026): FY27 EBITDA '20.5 to 21.2' after AI/products investment. Q1FY27 17.2%, Q2FY27 17.8% (company); Q2FY27 CEO: 'it will be early next year when we get there'. The rule deliberately ignores in-year progress. Resolution: YES if KPIT's reported FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin (company definition, Q4 FY27 release/presentation/call) is >= 20.5%, to one decimal. Screener OPM is NOT used (FY26 18.9% vs company 20.8%). Source: KPIT Q4 FY27 press release / investor presentation / call (NSE). Resolve by 2027-05-31; score with Brier vs the base rate, to test whether the credibility adjustment adds skill.

data.adjustment_applied: p0 = 0.74 (leave-one-out peer strict delivery rate, category 'margin', all-category fallback, n=6); SAC +6.6 pts x weight 0.2 (N=5) -> p = 0.75
data.adjustment_rule: p0 = leave-one-out pooled STRICT delivery rate (specificity-weighted share 'delivered'; partly=0) of the other 3 peers in the promise's category (all-category peer rate if <8 peer promises in that category). p = clip(p0 + N/(N+20) x SAC/100, 0.05, 0.95), N = company's scored promises, SAC in points (credit basis: delivered 1, partly 0.5; categories with n<5, or with <2 peers having data, pooled). P(base) = p0.
data.base_rate_reasoning: Naive forecaster = sector delivery rate for 'margin' promises among the other IT mid-cap peers (strict: delivered only, specificity-weighted; n=6, too few in category so all-category peer rate used). No company-specific information.
data.resolution_rule: YES if KPIT's reported FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin (company definition, Q4 FY27 release/presentation/call) is >= 20.5%, to one decimal. Screener OPM is NOT used (FY26 18.9% vs company 20.8%).
data.resolution_source: KPIT Q4 FY27 press release / investor presentation / call (NSE)

title: Paper call: KPIT FY27 EBITDA margin (company-reported) is >=20.5%
